system.description:
The manifester forges a telepathic bond with another person or creature, which must have an Intelligence score of 6 or higher.

The manifester can communicate telepathically through the bond even if he or she does not share a common language with the subject. No special power or influence is established as a result of the bond and the target is not compelled to communicate with the manifester. Once the bond is formed, it works over any distance.
system.target: You and one other creature who is initially no more than 30 ft. away
